title: The symmetric profiled-Gaussian cat has an exact rank-one Fisher sandwich

fisher_sandwich.cat_law: Let nu_cat=(N(m,S)+N(-m,S))/2 in the real covariance coordinates, with common positive profiled covariance S and constant zero-mode mean vector m.
fisher_sandwich.convex_upper: Weighted relative Fisher convexity gives I_Omega(nu_cat|mu)<=U=m^T Omega m+Tr[Omega(S+S^(-1)-2I)], the common component Fisher information.
fisher_sandwich.moment_lower: The cat has mean zero and covariance T=S+mm^T. K1533 gives I_Omega(nu_cat|mu)>=L=Tr[Omega(T+T^(-1)-2I)].
fisher_sandwich.rank_one_width: Sherman--Morrison and cancellation of the linear covariance/mean terms give U-L=Tr[Omega(S^(-1)-T^(-1))]=[m^T S^(-1) Omega S^(-1)m]/[1+m^T S^(-1)m].
fisher_sandwich.profiled_scale: Because m is the zero-mode eigenvector, U-I_Omega<=omega_0 |m|^2/[s_(N,0)(s_(N,0)+|m|^2)]<=omega_0/s_(N,0)=sqrt(omega_0^2+kappa_(g,N)^+)=Theta_g(N).
fisher_sandwich.scope_guard: This exact sandwich is for the symmetric two-component profiled cat. It does not control arbitrary multimodal, asymmetric, spatially textured or nonstationary negative-defect laws.
